description: This PHP source file defines the Drawing class for handling image drawings in a spreadsheet worksheet. It includes methods for setting the image path, retrieving image info, handling URLs, and supporting image type conversions.

classes.name: Drawing
classes.description: Represents an image drawing within a worksheet, supporting file path management, URL handling, image type conversions, and related operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Drawing object, setting default values and calling parent constructor.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename derived from the image path.

methods.name: getIndexedFilename
methods.description: Returns a hashed filename based on the path and extension.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Extracts and returns the file extension from the path.

methods.name: getMediaFilename
methods.description: Generates the filename used for media storage, considering image type conversion.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the image source path, handling local files, URLs, and embedded base64 images; verifies images and manages permissions.

methods.name: isImage
methods.description: Private method that detects if a given file path is an image based on MIME type and extension.

methods.name: getIsURL
methods.description: Returns whether the image path is a URL.

methods.name: setIsURL
methods.description: Sets the URL flag for the image (deprecated).

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the current state of the drawing object.

methods.name: getImageTypeForSave
methods.description: Returns the image type constant suitable for saving, based on current type.

methods.name: getImageFileExtensionForSave
methods.description: Returns the file extension for the image type used for saving.

methods.name: getImageMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the current image.
